description.zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

description.zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串。
description.en: The token that marks the end of the current page of results. To retrieve the next page, include this token in the next request. If this is your first request or the last page is returned, the value is an empty string.

description.zh:
拉取数据的条数。如果不设置，默认值为1。

取值范围：\[1,100\]。
description.en:
The number of entries to return. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 1.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

descriptions.zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版仅支持查看在线Consumer客户端，不支持查看离线Consumer客户端。
descriptions.en: ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ lets you query only online consumer clients. You cannot query offline consumer clients.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open list-queue-consumers --instance-id amqp-cn-5yd3aw000000 --virtual-host test --queue queue-rabbit-springboot-advance5 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --query-count 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun amqp-open ListQueueConsumers --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --InstanceId 'amqp-cn-5yd3aw000000' --QueryCount 1 --VirtualHost test --Queue 'queue-rabbit-springboot-advance5'
